_comment: Copy to data/signal_definitions.json on the server. Signals listed here are DEFINED per docs/trading_rules.md; anything not listed stays observe/log only.
TICK: 1m bar close price feed (FVG Narrator). Not tradeable; keeps the account marked to market.
FVG_CREATED: A fair value gap formed; extra carries top/bottom. Context for R2.2/R2.3.
FVG_ENTERED: Price traded back into an unmitigated FVG — the R2.3 entry trigger when the full R2 checklist is satisfied.
FVG_MITIGATED: Gap fully wicked through; the zone is spent.
FVG_INVERTED: Price CLOSED through the gap — R3.5 early-kill trigger when against an open position.
BULLISH_BREAK: BOS/CHoCH up; whether continuation or reversal depends on prior structure (R2 context).
SWEEP_HIGH: Wick through a high-side liquidity level (PDH/ONH/EQH) with rejection within 2 candles — R2.1, fade implication short.
SWEEP_LOW: Wick through a low-side liquidity level (PDL/ONL/EQL) with rejection within 2 candles — R2.1, fade implication long.
LEVEL_ACCEPTED: 2+ consecutive closes beyond a level — R2.4, that fade-side is dead until price re-enters the range.
DISPLACEMENT: R2.2 candle: body >= 1.5x avg(10), broke the last swing, left an FVG (bounds in extra).
